ruled_out.hypothesis: H3/H9: Malicious SingleProvider hook returns fake price
ruled_out.blocked_by: Pool hook set at pool creation by pool creator. LP determined by hook. Attacker creating malicious hook trades against themselves. No external victim.

Guard at L245: if (poolState.liquidity > 0) revert. Also checks all initialized ticks with liquidity between current and target price (L261-271). Price can only snap when NO active liquidity in entire traversal path.
ruled_out.verdict: skip — no extraction path when liquidity is 0

ruled_out.hypothesis: H4: Direct swap bypasses pricing bounds (CP-004 variant)
ruled_out.blocked_by: Known CP-004. For direct swaps, beforeSwap stores amount in transient slot, afterSwap reads it. Only bypassed when afterSwap flag is disabled — token creator's flag configuration choice.
ruled_out.verdict: skip — known finding, self-inflicted config, Tier B at best

ruled_out.hypothesis: H1: Round-trip rounding extraction in DynamicPool (INV-SW02/SW03)
ruled_out.blocked_by: Input amounts round UP (getAmount0Delta(..., true)). Output amounts round DOWN (getAmount1Delta(..., false)). Fee amounts use mulDivRoundingUp. All favor the pool. Standard Uniswap V3 rounding policy.
calculateFixedInput uses FullMath.mulDiv (rounds down output). calculateFixedOutput uses FullMath.mulDivRoundingUp (rounds up required input). Both favor pool.

ruled_out.hypothesis: Flash loan + swap reentrancy price manipulation
ruled_out.blocked_by: Flash loan flag (bit 11) doesn't overlap swap flags (bits 2-6), so swaps ARE allowed during flash loan callback. However, this is by-design. Attacker can't profit from self-initiated swaps due to IL and pool fees deducted on each swap. No price state is stale during flash loan callback.

ruled_out.hypothesis: Flash loan fee token mismatch (Lens 1 denomination trace)
ruled_out.blocked_by: Fee token determined by _executeTokenFlashloanHooks. Balance validation at L3310-3315 independently checks both loanToken and feeToken balances. Fee amount calculation (L3299-3303) denominated in feeToken. Storage at L3375 stores (loanToken, feeToken, tokenSettings, tokenFeeAmount) — denomination consistent.
ruled_out.verdict: skip — token creator controlled, denomination consistent, no external victim

ruled_out.hypothesis: H5/H6/H7/H8: Stale oracle / external pricing hook
ruled_out.blocked_by: AMM only checks MIN_SQRT_RATIO < price < MAX_SQRT_RATIO (L328-330). Hook deployed and controlled by pool creator/LP. Oracle staleness is hook developer's responsibility. AMM framework has no built-in oracle.
ruled_out.verdict: skip — oracle quality is hook developer's responsibility, not protocol bug

ruled_out.blocked_by: For input swaps: if (amountOut < swapOrder.limitAmount) revert (L2156). For output swaps: if (amountIn > swapOrder.limitAmount) revert (L2171). Deadline checked at entry: if (deadline < block.timestamp) revert.

ruled_out.hypothesis: Reentrancy during queued hook fee transfer execution
ruled_out.blocked_by: tokensOwed decremented before transfer (L3129), preventing double-withdraw. All pool state (reserves, fees) fully committed before queue execution. Queue length zeroed at L3189. Reentrant swap creates normal sequential operation with fully committed state.
ruled_out.verdict: skip — state fully committed before fee transfers, no stale state to exploit

mandatory_probes.detail: Rounding favors protocol in all 3 pool types (DynamicPool, FixedPool, SingleProvider)

mandatory_probes.name: Forged hook caller
mandatory_probes.detail: onlyAMM() modifier on all pool type entry points; hooks queried via hook address stored in pool state

mandatory_probes.name: Transient-slot theft
mandatory_probes.detail: Known CP-004, self-inflicted config. Queue uses dedicated transient slots at 0x9A1D namespace

mandatory_probes.name: Permit mutation
mandatory_probes.detail: limitAmount in SwapOrder protects signer's minimum output regardless of feeOnTop

mandatory_probes.name: Storage-slot collision
mandatory_probes.detail: Pool types are separate contracts called via external calls (not delegatecall), with isolated storage

L1_TRACE: Traced fee values through beforeSwap hook -> _applySwapByInputInputFees -> pool swap -> _applySwapByInputOutputFees -> _finalizeSwapCollectFundsAndDisburse. Denomination consistent at every handoff.
Traced flash loan fee path: feeToken can differ from loanToken. Balance validation for each token is independent (L3310-3315). Fee stored with correct denomination (L3375-3378).
Traced hook fee storage: _storeHookFees(tokenFor, tokenFee, ...) matches actual fee token at every call site.
L2_DIFF: Diffed addLiquidity vs removeLiquidity — symmetric validation, reserve direction correctly inverted.
Diffed singleSwap vs directSwap — directSwap skips pool type call, hooks still execute. Known asymmetry in pricing bounds (CP-004).
Diffed swapByInput vs swapByOutput fee paths — input allows 100% fee, output rejects at 100%. Intentional (avoids div-by-zero).
L3_AMP: Checked all fee multiplications for denomination mismatch. No amplification factor > 1x found.
Checked hook fee amounts — bounded by swap amount in _applySwapByInputInputFees (revert if feeAmount > swapAmountIn at L2616).
